svg.title: ForwardMesh cross-subnet auto-routing architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing the fwd client sending Protocol V2 requests into an fwdd relay node where MeshRouter learns routes, syncs path vectors with downstream peers, and drives cut-through streaming or single-pass tee caching to the target endpoint.
svg.text: auto-completes omitted hops & reroutes around failures; zero-disk 64 KB cut-through
